forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Putting known-record targets into the A1/MW16 parameter experiment
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The A1/MW16 experiment samples new parameters directly. Its candidate generator and worker exclude known-record targets, parameters, ranks, points, target j-invariants, and jump labels; record reconstruction remains a separate experiment.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Treating R17/MW17 as the unique rank-32 critical path or treating the six norm-twelve atlas misses as exclusions from other K3 fibrations
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The complete atlas excludes curves273,302 and398 only from its six classes. Curve398 has a recovered A1/MW16 fibration; its duplicate survivor presentations do not supply two generic structures. Curve302 now has the explicit alternative determinant1092 parent and full saturated generic MW17 basis certified by EC-CURVE302-RECOVERED-MW17-PARENT. Original discoverer provenance remains UNKNOWN. These paths have different generic ranks and demonstrated jumps; no lane is the unique rank32 critical path.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Treating translated bisection trace shells as new independent rank directions
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The exact published-R17 visibility audit shows that the translated shells span only the already-visible one-dimensional direction on the rank-28 control and leave a ten-dimensional target complement.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Promoting signatures, norm-one elements, incomplete class data, local candidates, or descent timeouts to residual Selmer rank or to a production exclusion
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Only the actual completed quotient Selmer dimension supplies a Selmer upper-bound decision. The listed proxies and backend timeouts are non-results for that proof gate; they may schedule a finite search but cannot veto it mathematically.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Searching curves 273 or 302 as direct rational fibres of the published R17 chart
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Exact projective preimage tests exclude both record curves from that rational chart, although other constructions remain possible.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Using finite CRT beam survival as a completeness sieve
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Exact four-prime regression shows that branch ordering can change: a width-one beam ends at height 1409 after discarding a branch that completes at height 53. True minimum height is nondecreasing along a fixed branch, but omitted CRT states remain untested.
